text.en: Understand your business and investment objectives.
Evaluate the activity, structure, location and requirements.
Complete the necessary approvals and registrations.
Form the company and complete the official procedures.
Prepare tax, finance, office, HR and business operations.
text.ar: تجهيز الضرائب والمالية والمكتب والموارد البشرية وعمليات العمل.

text.en: Build your strategy, positioning and commercial direction.
Expand, optimize and develop the business.
